hypotheses.justification: It follows from the remaining assumptions. Given h : u ≤ v, add_tsub_le_right gives (u + t) - t ≤ u, hence (u + t) - t ≤ v. Applying tsub_le_iff_right yields u + t ≤ v + t. Commutativity therefore supplies AddLeftMono locally, after which the original proof works unchanged. This argument also covers empty and trivial types; it requires no nonemptiness or cancellation.
